copy.headline: Goo Goo Dolls’ Halftime Show at the Chiefs vs. Bills Thanksgiving Game: Watch Online for Free
copy.caption: The game will take place on Thanksgiving Night (Nov. 26), with the rock band taking the stage at halftime. Fans can also tune in for a potential Taylor Swift and Hailee Steinfeld spotting.
